name: The Rava Liberation Front's fighters in the southern valley
status: F3.1 (21 Nov 2026): data only (docs/fronts/03_GROUND_WAR.md sections 8 and 11). Nothing reads it on the campaign path until F3.3; simcore/ground_war/ground_data.hpp loads it and tests/test_ground_data.cpp checks it.
source: SAM3D estimate: the research gives patterns, not norms (docs/research/FRONTS_RESEARCH_2026-11.md section 4): rebels without air defence cannot hold ground against an air force (cia_1986_nicaragua_af); they raid where we are thin, mostly by night. The owner's open decision 2 taken as proposed (docs/fronts/README.md)
notes: Brigade-sized groups with light equipment and a few captured vehicles. They hold a ragged front in the southern valley and raid where we are thin, by night, then disperse rather than retreat as a unit. All numbers placeholders.

oob.name: The Rava Liberation Front's fighting groups
oob.source: estimate (SAM3D): brigade-sized groups of light infantry with mortars, recoilless guns, armed pick-ups and a few captured armoured vehicles; numbers placeholders

personnel.basis: estimate: the command, its guard and couriers

pool.source: game value: as the Front's air officers (data/air_war/faction_rebels.json officer_pool)

authored.name: Josip Radic
authored.bio: Knows every track in the southern forest. Fights by night and never where the army is ready.

doctrine.source: SAM3D estimate from cia_1986_nicaragua_af (docs/fronts/03_GROUND_WAR.md section 8): no hold against an air force; raids where we are thin, mostly by night; disperse rather than retreat

attack_ratio.source: estimate (SAM3D): a raid goes in only where the Front's local ratio is high

withdraw_needs_order.source: estimate (SAM3D): groups slip away on their own leaders' word

disperse_rather_than_retreat.source: estimate (SAM3D) from cia_1986_nicaragua_af: without air defence they cannot hold ground against an air force

attack_stop_losses.source: estimate (SAM3D): a raid breaks off early, the group conserves itself

defence_break_losses.source: estimate (SAM3D): a group under heavy fire disperses

breakthrough.source: estimate (SAM3D): their advance capped at a few km a day (docs/fronts/03_GROUND_WAR.md section 8)

frontages_km.source: estimate (SAM3D): a ragged line held by small groups
estimate (SAM3D): a raid on one object

start_after_h.source: SAM3D estimate: the rising's fighting goes on from the war's first hour

plan.source: SAM3D estimate: the owner's open decision 2 taken as proposed (docs/fronts/README.md; docs/fronts/03_GROUND_WAR.md section 8)
plan.notes: No axis of advance: the brigades hold their stretches of the ragged line and raid what is near and weakly held.

night_only.source: estimate (SAM3D) from cia_1986_nicaragua_af: by night, when our air is not near

min_ratio.source: estimate (SAM3D): only where their local ratio is high

max_depth_km.source: estimate (SAM3D): a night's march in and out
